content:
Hi all,
I have a question from one of our users about the dataset templates.
If you create a draft dataset and select a template, and save the draft, you are not able to select another template anymore. Is this expected behavior from dataverse? (we are using version 6.10.1)

I can imagine dataverse doesn't allow it, because saved metadata might be lost. But on the other hand, sometimes people make mistakes in selecting the wrong template :sweat_smile:

I can't find a paragraph in the User Guide about selecting templates, I only see a paragraph about creating the templates.

Maybe someone can confirm that this is how it currently works?
Hmm, I see what you mean. When you go to create a dataset, there's a dropdown to select a template (left, below) but once you've clicked save and go to edit the draft, the dropdown is gone (right):
The modern frontend works the same way so I assume it's intentional:

From https://guides.dataverse.org/en/6.12.1/user/dataverse-management.html#dataset-templates I'd say that this is a bit of a clue that templates are de-coupled from the saved dataset: "When a template is deleted, it does not impact the datasets that have used the template already."

It goes on to say, "users can select which template they would like to use while on the Create Dataset page".

We could be more clear that's it's only on create, not edit.
From a code perspective, here is the logic (in the old UI) that we only show the dropdown on create, not edit.

Ah, I was wrong. These days, at least after #8775 was merged, templates are no longer de-coupled from datasets. This is so custom instructions can continue to be shown on edit.

This is related to the issue that @Steven Ferey opened: Template deletion not possible if at least one dataset uses it #11008

Thanks for all the information! Really appreciated. Now I know that nothing strange is going on in our installation. I am not sure if it deserves a JIRA issue with a feature request, as it also makes sense to not be able to change a template when a lot of values are already saved and might be deleted.
